# 0.4.0 launcher, profiles and distribution

Design: retain .NET Framework WinForms for the small native distribution. Modernize its visual treatment using OpenGrid XR's dark violet palette, softer cards, sidebar hierarchy and consistent spacing. Keep existing rendering, Steam startup, benchmark and joystick behavior.

Integrate Markus Stahl's portable profile model and page, credit him. Shared profiles must never alter paths, devices, diagnostics or headset calibration. Validate imports as untrusted XML. Preserve unsaved local choices when applying a profile.

Offer a signed per-user Windows installer and portable ZIP. Installed files use a writable per-user folder, so existing package-relative settings remain usable. Upgrades preserve settings/profiles/logs; uninstall preserves user data and removes automatic startup only through existing safe elevated removal. Never rename OpenXR registry keys.

Updater: automatic stable-release availability check, user-approved download and installation. Fetch only this project's GitHub release installer, validate digest plus timestamped Authenticode publisher. Block install while LMU runs. Portable users can install the offered setup or download the ZIP themselves; no silent file replacement. Release signing only, no signing for iterative tests.

Implementation plan:
- [x] Profile store/import validation, native Profiles page and tests (Markus patch reviewed before integration).
- [x] Update service with pure metadata tests and signature/installation safeguards.
- [x] Small installer build and upgrade/uninstall preservation checks.
- [x] Native UI modernization, update panel and integration.
- [x] Full launcher/native tests, visual review across pages and DPI cases.
- [ ] Version/docs/credits, signed installer and ZIP, GitHub distribution.

Existing uncommitted SteadyXR autoload-policy changes remain outside this release.

Validation: full launcher/native suites passed; installer fixture and actual per-user install/upgrade/uninstall smoke passed with settings, profiles and unknown files retained. Updater and profile trust tests pass. CPU changes and capability-only NVIDIA probe are documented in docs/CPU-040.md; no matched game-ms gain is claimed. EAC published0.3.3 signatures verified; reporter integrity check added, EAC acceptance unresolved. Final distribution is rebuilt from git-archive to exclude pre-existing uncommitted autoload-policy changes.
